test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

PROTEST (v.)
solution: The correct answer is '**object**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Protest**' is '**Object**'. • **Protest**: to say or show that you do not approve of or agree with something, especially publicly. ((विशेषतः सार्वजनिक) विरोध प्रदर्शन करना) • *Example: Students have been **protesting** against the government’s decision.* • **)Object**: to not like or to be against somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद करना, उसके विरुद्घ होना • *Example: Many people **object** to the new tax.* **Correct Answer:__** *Object.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Favour**: to support somebody/something; to prefer. (को समर्थन देना; अधिक पसंद करना) • **Assist**: to help. (सहायता करना) • **Support**: to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. (किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना) 39:Tb42, The correct answer is '**interloper**'.
